themes.title: Populist Economic Relief Promises and Tax Cuts Ahead of Elections
themes.blurb: Right-wing parties in both Sweden and the United States are building their election messaging around direct financial relief for voters suffering from high living costs. Sweden Democrats are promising targeted tax cuts on fuel, energy, and food, while MAGA Republicans in the US promote direct cash dividends to win over households impacted by inflation.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: Proposes cutting taxes on fuel, electricity, and food to reduce household costs ahead of parliamentary elections.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Trump pledges a $5,000 cash dividend to voters to counter inflation and rising living expenses during midterm campaigning.

themes.title: Nationalist Pressures to Reshape Immigration Policies and Border Control
themes.blurb: Right-wing populist movements in both countries continue to advance strict anti-immigration stances as a core pillar of their political identity. In Sweden, the Sweden Democrats' electoral rise threatens to permanently dismantle the nation's open migration legacy, while US MAGA leadership emphasizes tough enforcement, birthright values, and faces legal battles over ICE operations.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: Leverages electoral strength to push Sweden away from historically open migration policies towards strict restrictionism.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Emphasizes strict immigration enforcement, birthright values, and faces lawsuits over ICE arrest tactics.

themes.title: Right-Wing Mainstreaming and Power Consolidation Ahead of Key Elections
themes.blurb: Right-wing populist forces in both Sweden and the United States are positioning themselves to dictate national political alignments and executive authority. The Sweden Democrats stand on the verge of entering government through a razor-thin election race, mirroring how the MAGA movement is cementing its institutional control over the Republican Party leadership.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: Nears potential government participation as Sweden's election hangs on a 0.3 percentage point margin between blocs.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Consolidates party control and showcases JD Vance as the MAGA heir during the RNC midterm convention.
